requirements.title: Search customer

source.quote: Search is case-insensitive and matches partial names.

requirements.description: Sales staff can search customers by name or phone number from the customer list screen.
business_rules: Search is case-insensitive and matches partial names

acceptance_criteria.when: the user searches by part of a name in any letter case

requirements.title: Create customer
requirements.description: A sales manager can create a customer with name, phone and email; phone must be unique.
business_rules: Only sales managers can create customers

acceptance_criteria.given: a sales manager on the create form
acceptance_criteria.when: they submit a valid name, phone and email

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer with phone P exists
acceptance_criteria.when: a manager creates another customer with phone P
acceptance_criteria.then: the error "Phone number already registered" is shown

ambiguities.question: Is email required and must it be unique?

assumptions: Email format is validated with standard rules

requirements.title: Customer detail
requirements.description: Selecting a customer opens a detail screen showing name, phone, email and created date.

acceptance_criteria.then: the detail screen shows name, phone, email and created date

requirements.title: Search performance
requirements.description: Search results return within 1 second for 100,000 customers.
requirements.notes: Deferred by developer: needs a performance environment.
